intent: An explicit readiness request must activate the skill and run the full validation proof from the target root.
prompt: Run a pre-deploy check on this repository and tell me whether it is ready to deploy.

must: detect the stack from the target root before claiming the skill applies
run the full skills/pre-deploy/scripts/deploy-check.mjs from the repository root
report detected stacks, passed/failed/skipped checks, and blockers
claim readiness only after a passing full deploy check
mustNot: claim readiness from a single quality phase or from a skipped check
edit files without a reproduced blocker

intent: A Korean pre-release validation request must activate the skill and default the report to Korean.

must: target root에서 stack detection을 먼저 실행한다
readiness report를 한국어로 쓰고 skipped check를 passed와 분리한다
mustNot: 질문 없이 deploy나 release 명령을 실행한다

intent: A validate-only request must activate the skill in report mode with no edits.
prompt: Audit whether this workspace passes the pre-deploy gate, but do not change any files.

must: enter validate-only mode and report blockers without editing
still run the full deploy-check for the detected stack
mustNot: apply a fix because the blocker looks obvious
create or resume .hyper/pre-deploy/flow.json in validate-only mode

intent: Multi-stack reproduced failures must activate the skill and classify upward into tracked remediation.
prompt: node typecheck와 rust clippy가 배포 전 검사에서 둘 다 깨졌어. 원인 찾아서 고쳐줘.

must: initial full deploy-check로 baseline failure를 먼저 캡처한다
여러 stack에 걸친 실패를 complex로 분류하고 tracked remediation을 쓴다
각 수정 뒤 targeted check를 재실행하고 마지막에 full deploy-check를 다시 실행한다
mustNot: 두 stack을 동시에 고치면서 같은 shared config를 양쪽 lane에 맡긴다

intent: A concrete platform deploy failure belongs to a deployment-log remediation pass, not to this gate.
prompt: Vercel 배포가 missing environment variable 오류로 실패했어. 배포 로그를 보고 고쳐줘.

must: 배포 로그와 플랫폼 설정을 산출물로 다루는 작업으로 라우팅한다
mustNot: pre-deploy remediation으로 흡수해 저장소 안의 lint/typecheck/build만 고친다

intent: A reproduced runtime defect belongs to a reproduction-backed defect repair, not to this gate.
prompt: Deploy succeeded, but the cart total doubles after a coupon is applied. Repro: add two coupons, then open checkout.

must: treat the deliverable as a minimal code change plus the reproduction that proves it
mustNot: run the full deploy-check as the deliverable

intent: New feature work with no reproduced blocker must not be absorbed into pre-deploy remediation.
prompt: Add a GitHub Actions workflow that publishes the package on tag push.

must: route the request to scoped implementation work
mustNot: run the deploy-check gate as the deliverable
invent a pre-deploy blocker to justify edits

intent: An explicit gate request against an unsupported repository must stop at detection instead of entering a fake fix loop.
prompt: Run the pre-deploy gate on this docs-only folder. It has no package.json, Cargo.toml, or pyproject.toml.

must: run stack detection from the target root
report that pre-deploy does not apply and stop
mustNot: enter a fix loop with no reproduced blocker
invent build commands for an unsupported stack
